statements.action_statement: At PR #12551's base commit 03524a4c449017314ef4fa48e6ba8cea07dea496, the Admin UI package-lock resolved transitive KaTeX 0.16.47 through Mermaid 12.0.0. Upstream GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 identifies inherited trust after pre-existing prototype pollution as the vulnerable behavior; application exploitability has not been demonstrated. PR #12551 pins KaTeX 0.18.2 and adds a regression test that rejects inherited trust. Keep this finding affected until that PR passes required hosted checks and independent review, merges, and a new Admin UI release evidence bundle confirms the patched resolved artifact. Reassess the statement as fixed only against that release artifact.
